offering_description.value: Provides consulting, engineering, program management and technical services focused on water, environment, sustainable infrastructure, renewable energy and international development. Clients are government agencies and commercial businesses. Work is delivered by technical staff through project-based and contract engagements.

primary_services.value: water resources engineering; environmental consulting and remediation; infrastructure design; program and construction management; renewable energy and international development consulting

customer_segment.value: B2G: US federal agencies (EPA, DoD, USAID), state and local governments, municipal utilities; B2B: commercial clients in utilities, energy, mining, and industrial sectors

end_markets.value: water; environment; infrastructure; energy and renewables; government and defense; international development

revenue_model.value: service fees: time-and-materials and cost-plus consulting and engineering work; project or contract: fixed-price and long-term government contracts for design, management and remediation

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses professional staff and subcontractors to deliver engineering and consulting to government and commercial clients

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Australia, United Kingdom, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: water, environment, infrastructure, energy and international development consulting and engineering

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct bidding and contracts with government agencies and commercial clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental and engineering services subject to EPA rules, professional licensing and government contracting regulations (FAR)
